limits: Bounded block plan with VictoriaStreet175–230m connecting strip to Fairway roundabout. Estimated widths±0.8–2m, walls±1–3m and heights±2–3m. Neutral roof bounds, no reconstructed facade details. Marine Lake north of MarineParade; southern lake/park, pier and west OceanPlaza half deferred. Dunes/grades/thresholds not surveyed. Former theatre shown as provisional construction reservation following official2025 demolition evidence; current excavations/ramp/retaining wall geometry unresolved.
bridge_uncertainty: Deck width14.2±1.6m from mapped parallel footways/3D; 28±5m pylon visual silhouette, approximate stay anchors. Schematic block-plan structure, not engineering model.

mini_roundabout.basis: Google actual close orbit/flat plan at53.6554945,-3.003 shows white mini-roundabout disc and two broad mouths; OSM circular axes do not establish a raised island.

neighbour_exclusion_basis: Exact existing MarineParade/Promenade ground polygons: pavement extends beyond roadY310 toY312 and reachesY314.43 atX85. New canvas yields that ownership, including paint/kerbs, instead of copying a rectangular cap.
